name: Crusader’s Blades (CR 2)
body:
Crusader’s Blades

CR 2

XP 600

Type mechanical; Perception DC 20; Disable Device DC 20

EFFECTS

Trigger location; Reset manual

Effect Atk +10 melee (×2) (1d8+1/19–20); multiple targets (all targets between a pair of statues)

There is a pressure plate located between a pair of statues. Stepping on this plate causes all of the statues to suddenly swing their swords downward, making attacks against anyone caught between them. Once the trap has been triggered, the swords remain in place, creating a barrier that is difficult to navigate, as creatures must climb over the angled swords. Treat the squares between the statues as difficult terrain . Additionally, anyone attempting to climb between the statues must make a DC 10 Acrobatics or Escape Artist check to avoid taking 1d4 points of damage from the blades.
